query: Is the Northwind Pro plan a good fit for a small marketing team?
notes: Price/spec presence vs. absence. Variant A states concrete price and specs; Variant B makes the same claims qualitatively, with no numbers. Length held close.

variantA.label: Concrete price and specs
variantA.text: The Northwind Pro plan suits small marketing teams. It costs $49 per month, includes 500 GB of storage, supports up to 10 seats, and offers priority email support during standard business hours.

variantB.label: No price or specs
variantB.text: The Northwind Pro plan suits small marketing teams. It is competitively priced, includes generous storage, supports a full team, and offers priority email support during standard business hours.
